observability_limits: Caller/keeper and inner groups/CIDs use exact saved process identities and active container witnesses; inner successful UART installation/restoration remains an attestation, not independent full flash subprocess reconstruction.

Post-result keeper replacement is documented by replacement-lease identity/spawn/quarantine receipts; earlier result.quarantine identifies the formerly retained keeper, so manual recovery must use latest exact keeper records.

The first supplemental probe incorrectly expected result.quarantine to be rewritten after the post-result replacement; its failure is retained and final probe checks live replacement lease subreceipt plus actual flock.
Unknown ownership/failed keeper replacement intentionally keeps a live process and lock for qualified manual recovery; it is not a bounded successful episode.
Failed terminal receipt alone may contain completed-looking bytes if disk correction fails; final pending absence plus successful parent status and full receipts are necessary for qualification.
OS/filesystem, Nix/Docker daemons and pre-Python launcher remain trusted; no new current daemon/controller/device observations made by peer.
